summary: Windows 11 (26300), 1.0.72, COM5, model 5RH Pro selected: the 16-byte magic was answered e0 then 41, and the 8-byte command 4e ('N'), so the radio talks but refuses the 5RH Pro handshake. Owner reports UV-5RM PRO, firmware 1_0_94, hardware 1_0_0. Not in CHIRP. Next: OEM CPS REA.
title: Support the UV-5RM Pro (firmware 1.0.94)
